title: Alien Cult on Mars
description: A surreal scene depicts a two-headed robed figure with white hair standing at a stone podium, holding a glowing purple orb and a hammer with a skull topper. Below, hooded cultists and grey aliens gather around another glowing orb on a pedestal, with one alien pointing upwards at a large red ringed planet in the dark sky. The background shows a gothic cathedral interior on the left with dripping golden clouds and lightning, transitioning to a barren rocky Martian landscape on the right with a lone explorer walking away.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a two-headed white-haired figure in ornate robes standing behind a stone podium inside a gothic cathedral, holding a glowing purple crystal ball and a hammer with skull handle, addressing a group of hooded cultists and grey aliens who stand before another glowing orb on a pedestal, one purple alien pointing up, dramatic lighting with purple and gold dripping clouds and lightning above, large red ringed planet like Mars dominating the dark teal sky, barren rocky desert landscape on the right with a lone explorer walking into the distance, intricate linework and vibrant colors
